definitions: A fantasy novel by R.J. Barker, the first book in 'The Tide Child' trilogy.
A series of fantasy novels by R.J. Barker, including 'The Bone Ships', 'Call of the Bone Ships', and 'The Splinter in the Sky'.
examples: I just finished reading The Bone Ships and loved it.
The Bone Ships trilogy is a must-read for fantasy fans.
